title: H22: hub credential identity is mimi://<hub domain>
description: protocol-06 never states the hub's own BasicCredential identity (used in external_senders, franking_agent.credential, hub_sender in groupInfo responses). Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: the provider's domain URI with no path, e.g. mimi://a.example; receivers can compare it with the room URI authority. wg item filed.
notes: 2026-10-19 assay of identity-05: the provider-URI form mimi://<domain> matches identity-05 Table 3 (L413). See localfix mimid-1wgh.6.76 (users must not share this identity).
